title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.0 Release Candidate 6
summary: Version 1.0.0 Release Candidate 6 separates mouse-edge switching from keyboard shortcuts and adds one master switch that keeps every assigned hotkey inactive by default without erasing saved assignments.
changes: Moves Easy Mouse out of Keyboard Shortcuts and presents it as a clear Switch computers at screen edge checkbox in Other Options.
Preserves the Always, Hold Ctrl, and Hold Shift mouse-edge activation modes in a separate selector.
Adds an Enable keyboard shortcuts master checkbox that defaults off for new and existing preference files that do not already contain the new setting.
Gates local and remotely injected configured hotkeys at runtime while preserving every individual assignment for later reuse.
Renames the per-shortcut Disable choices to None and reorganizes the shortcut panel into one master row plus three assignment rows.
testing: Upgrade an existing preferences file and confirm Enable keyboard shortcuts starts unchecked while the old individual assignments remain visible but inactive.
Enable the master switch and confirm each configured shortcut works; turn it off and confirm none of them fire.
Confirm the machine-switch row says None rather than Disable and that selecting it affects only that row.
In Other Options, turn screen-edge switching off and on and test Always, Hold Ctrl, and Hold Shift activation.
Resize and maximize Settings and confirm the new four-row shortcut layout stays evenly spaced and aligned.
Open About and confirm the displayed product version is 1.0.0-rc.6.
Run the same RC6 EXE on both computers and briefly recheck mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, and reconnect behavior.
